# Compatibility contract

What "drop-in compatible" means for Megabase, bounded to the pins in
`vendor.toml`. Accepted by the agent coordinator with
[proposal 0001](proposals/0001-external-review.md).

When the source and the docs disagree, the source wins. When the source and
the reference stack disagree, the reference stack wins (GOAL.md section 2).

## In scope

The units in `coverage/units.json`, grouped below. Clients talk to the
gateway prefixes in [ADR 0002](adr/0002-gateway-layout.md).

- **REST `/rest/v1`**: table CRUD, RPC, PostgREST operators, `Prefer`,
  media types, embedding, aggregates.
- **Auth `/auth/v1`**: email/password, JWT, `auth.users` / `auth.uid()` /
  `auth.jwt()`, then OAuth, OTP, magic links, MFA, admin.
- **Realtime `/realtime/v1`**: websocket, broadcast, presence, replication.
- **Storage `/storage/v1`**: buckets, objects, signed URLs, TUS, `storage.objects` RLS.
- **Functions `/functions/v1`**: invoke + Edge Runtime ops.
- **Pooler**: transaction / session / statement modes (PostgreSQL wire, not the HTTP gateway).
- **Meta `/pg`**: introspection and DDL Studio uses.
- **Studio**: official Studio as a judge first; a Rust rewrite only at Level 5.

## Out of scope

- PostgreSQL itself and its extensions.
- Hosted-platform features that are not in the self-hosted stack (billing,
  orgs, cloud management API).
- Kong/Nginx as a process (the gateway is `megabase-server`).
- Updating `vendor/` pins (frozen; human-owned).

## States

| State | Treemap | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| not done | `#2A2C2F` (light: `#DCDDDE`) | 501, or not claimed in `crates/` |
| implemented | `#005441` | `// megabase:unit <id>` in `crates/` |
| tested | `#009366` | implemented and listed in `judge/cases/` |
| conformant | `#00D892` | every such case passed in the Judge results that produced the summary |

Coverage = implemented ÷ units. Conformance = passing judge cases ÷ cases.
A unit is **done** only when it is conformant. The committed
`coverage/judge-results.json` is the regression baseline. Live counts on
the README, the shields badges, and megabase.sh come from the Judge
artifact on `main`.

## Behavioral contract

Same endpoints, request syntax, status, JSON shape, error codes, headers
the API documents (`content-type`, `content-range`, `location`,
`preference-applied`), and the database objects apps and RLS depend on.
Performance may differ; correctness may not.

Intentional divergences (none today) would be listed here and in
`PROGRESS.md`.
